sessions.title: Jonah’s Supplication
sessions.description: Understanding the methodology of reading a prophetic story

sessions.title: Adam
sessions.description: Adam lived in Paradise until he ate from the tree. In my life, what is paradise and where is the tree? Adam was then taught all the Names. What are the Names? Am I taught them too? How am I different than the angels?

sessions.title: Cain and Abe
sessions.description: “If you chose to kill me, I will not kill you”, Abe told Cain as he was being killed. What does this mean to me? Am I Cain or Abe? If someone is about to hurt, shall I become like Abe and fear God?

sessions.title: Noah
sessions.description:
Noah’s people were described as arrogance.

What is arrogance and how am I arrogant? What about Noah is relevant to me?

What is the ship?

sessions.title: Personal Reflections of a prophet of your choice
